title: How is Gaddafi connected to Clifford?
description:
A 2009 summit photo, a White House welcome and an Easter Egg Roll connect Libya's Muammar Gaddafi to Clifford the Big Red Dog.

Muammar Gaddafi → Barack Obama → Laura Bush → Clifford the Big Red Dog

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

Photo credits:
Photo 1 by White House (Pete Souza) / Maison Blanche (Pete Souza), Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:G8_summit_in_L%27Aquila,_family_photo.jpg
Photo 2 by Chad J. McNeeley, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Obamas_escort_Bushes_to_helicopter.jpg
Photo 3 by White House photo by Shealah Craighead, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Clifford_the_Big_Red_Dog_at_the_WhiteHouse_Easter_Egg_Roll,_2007Apr09.jpg
